messages:
Nora: Quick experiment — share a short story (link/title) + one song you'd pair with it for a 10–25 minute commute. I'll try to read+listen tomorrow. :coffee:

Felix: 'The Paper Menagerie' — pair w/ Sufjan Stevens 'Should Have Known Better' (melancholy, long-ish but fits a coffee stop).

Deepa: 'St. Lucy's Home for Girls Raised by Wolves' + Yeah Yeah Yeahs 'Maps' :heart_eyes: feels unexpected but works for the coming-of-age beats.

Joel: Ooh love that. My pick: 'Cat Person' + Mitski 'First Love / Late Spring' — heavy but short commute-grade.

Cassie: Tiny one: 'The Husband Stitch' (read an excerpt) + Fleet Foxes 'Blue Ridge Mountains' — rural, slow-burn vibe.

Nora: @spotify-bot can we get a 30-min playlist of these 4?

spotify-bot: Playlist created: "Short Reads x One Song" — https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3xExample :musical_note: (auto-added 4 tracks)

Felix: Also rec pairing: an extract from 'The Dead' + Nick Drake 'Northern Sky' for twilight drives.

Deepa: Anyone want to try a microfiction pick? 3–5 lines + a single song.

Joel: mine: 'For sale: baby shoes, never worn.' — pair w/ Radiohead 'Motion Picture Soundtrack' (tiny, haunting).

Cassie: Vote: best pairing — react with :thumbsup: on the one you'd actually read on commute.

Nora: I'll export the list to Notion later and ping this thread. Love the variety, thanks y'all :raised_hands:
